PixelChief now tells you when the game is not in English.

- **Game language.** PixelChief recognises the game's buttons by their English labels (*Attack!*, *Find a Match*, *Return Home*…) and reads the builder menu in English, so the game must be set to English: in Clash of Clans, *Settings → Language → English*. This changes the game only, not your phone or PC.
- **Clear message.** In another language the bot cannot find the *Attack!* button and does nothing (it never spends resources). Until now the log only said `attack.png not found`; after three missed searches in a row it now says: *Attack button not found 3 times in a row. PixelChief reads the game in English only…*

Everything in [v1.0.10](https://github.com/Leixien/pixelchief/releases/tag/v1.0.10) and [v1.0.11](https://github.com/Leixien/pixelchief/releases/tag/v1.0.11) applies.

Download **PixelChief.exe**. Tesseract is bundled. **PixelChief.exe.sha256** contains its SHA-256 checksum. The exe is unsigned, so SmartScreen warns on first launch.

Guide and tester form: https://leixien.github.io/pixelchief/
